description: Source code for IntellijGradleDetector class, a custom Gradle detector for Android lint inspections, parsing Groovy build scripts to identify specific Gradle configurations and properties.

classes.name: IntellijGradleDetector
classes.description: A custom Gradle detector class for Android lint, analyzing Groovy build scripts to identify specific Gradle configurations and properties.

methods.name: getClosureName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a Groovy closure based on its parent method call.

methods.name: visitBuildScript
methods.description: Main method that traverses the build script's Groovy AST to identify and process relevant Gradle configuration blocks and properties.

methods.name: getStartOffset
methods.description: Returns the start offset of a given PSI element.

methods.name: getPropertyPairCookie
methods.description: Returns the parent PSI element of the given element, used as a cookie for property pair analysis.

methods.name: getPropertyKeyCookie
methods.description: Returns the PSI element representing the property key, based on the parent element type.

methods.name: createLocation
methods.description: Creates a Location object for reporting, based on the PSI element's text range.
